_meta.purpose: Same-protocol SOTA references used by scripts/08_acceptance.py (§11).
_meta.tolerance_definition: g_m = (ref_m - ours_m) / ref_m must be <= 0.05 for PSNR and SSIM. PSNR is compared in dB, i.e. a 30 dB reference passes down to 28.5 dB. MSE is reported per image but is NEVER an acceptance criterion (§11 forbids substituting it).
_meta.resolution_note: All references below are 256x256 whole-image evaluations on the same target split (or the closest published split, flagged in note). Numbers taken from docs/sota_registry.csv row ids.
_meta.warning: Every entry is a FULLY SUPERVISED in-domain model trained on the target domain. Our method is source-only (no target labels at all). The gate is therefore deliberately strict: it asks whether an unsupervised adapter can come within 5% of a target-supervised model. Failing it is a meaningful research result and must be reported as such, not reframed.
_meta.fallback_when_missing: If a stream has no ref for a metric, scripts/08_acceptance.py marks the gate not_applicable rather than passing it.

LSUI2UIEB.note: Strongest published target-supervised number on the UIEB paired test protocol. UIEB-R90 in our spec is the 90-image held-out paired subset; S09 uses T90, the same 90-image protocol family.

UIEB2LSUI.note: Strongest published target-supervised number on LSUI-400. Our LSUI test split is 428 images from the same release; the 28-image difference is disclosed rather than hidden.

LSUI2UFO.note: UFO-120 pairs are 320x240 input vs 640x480 GT (a 2x SR task). §5.1's whole-image 256x256 resize is applied to BOTH members, which removes the SR component; this is recorded in the data manifest and no SR claim will be made.
